India's Retail Inflation Reaches 5.54% in September

India's retail inflation rose to 5.54% in September, an increase driven by higher food prices. Food inflation specifically surged to 7.74%. This figure exceeded previous estimates and strengthens the case for potential further interest rate hikes.
